content.short: Princeton Blockchain Club is a student-led organization focused on Web3 and blockchain education.
content.description: Princeton Blockchain Club is a student-led organization at Princeton University focused on expanding knowledge of Web3 and blockchain. The club organizes on-campus blockchain events to raise awareness and support students in developing solutions that leverage cryptographic technology. It also runs hands-on workshops and networking gatherings to connect Princeton students with leaders and peers shaping the blockchain landscape, fostering collaboration and practical experience.
